sources.access: Public HTML index; restaurant details; POST menu fragment using a date read from that restaurant page.

scope.coverage_statement: Broad, city-stratified sample only; not a census of all 353 restaurants. Sample selection took up to two entries from each alphabetically ordered city group and included a few known examples. Fourteen sampled detail pages exposed no usable menu date at collection time. The other 45 yielded titles through the offered-date menu endpoint. Some chains/delivery duplicates occur, so evidence is not statistically independent.

collection_method.selection: Read .restaurant-row data-posid, data-lokal, data-city and data-detailslink from the public index; selected up to two records per city group, then added specific known examples if absent, stopping at 59.
collection_method.date_handling: Used dates actually present in each detail page .menu-request-link onclick. Dates are recorded per restaurant; no fixed date was assumed. Retrieved one offered date per restaurant.
collection_method.requests: At most two concurrent HTTP requests; no retries. Menu fragment fetched by POST with restaurantId and the offered date.
collection_method.item_extraction: Captured h5 dish titles from .shadow-wrapper menu cards; accompaniments were considered during manual taxonomy review but titles are stored for concise reproducibility.
limitations: Menus are time-sensitive; one day is weak evidence for a permanent restaurant identity.
No usable offered date was exposed on 14 sampled pages; absence of a visible menu is not evidence that the restaurant has no menu.
The sample includes duplicate delivery/location variants, and the public index may change.
Slovenian menu wording and abbreviations can be ambiguous; classify conservatively and allow abstention.

taxonomy.design: Independent of official Boni service categories. Infer from repeated dish titles across one or more observed menus, never from restaurant name. Use separate dish-format and cuisine-direction facets; labels shown on the homepage must remain sparse.

facets.description: What kinds of dishes / meal forms recur in the menu. Multi-label allowed.

values.rule: Pizza/pica is an explicit recurring offer.
Pasta, špageti, njoki or noodle dishes recur.
Explicit grilled meat, fish or vegetables recur.
Salad bowls/plates are substantial repeated options.
Sandwiches, burgers, tortillas or wraps recur.
Rice bowls, stir-fries, wok or Asian rice/noodle plates recur.
Soups, obara, golaž, bograč or similar spoon dishes recur.
Schnitzel, ocvrt dishes, fried cheese or fried seafood recur.
Menu is a broad rotating set of composed cooked meals and no narrower format dominates.
Multiple explicitly named meat-free main dishes appear. This is a menu-content signal, not a guarantee of vegetarian preparation or cross-contact.

facets.description: A broad culinary direction evidenced by dish content, not names. Multi-label allowed for genuinely mixed menus.

values.rule: Repeated explicitly Chinese/Sichuan/Asian dishes such as chop suey, sweet-sour, wok, rice noodles.
Repeated ćevapčiči, pleskavica, lepinja, kajmak or šopska combinations.
Repeated pizza/pasta/risotto with recognizable Italian dish forms; pizza alone may support format but not always this direction.
Repeated falafel, hummus, shawarma or related dishes explicitly visible.
Repeated schnitzel, local stews, roast/potato plates or named Slovenian regional dishes.
Use only if substantial repeated menu sections span unrelated directions and none dominates; this is a fallback, not an inference from restaurant branding.

homepage_policy.ranking: At most two meal_format labels plus one cuisine_direction label. Rank by evidence share among distinct main-dish titles in the latest 2-4 fetched menu dates; require at least 3 supporting dishes and >=30% share for a format, >=40% for a cuisine direction. For mixed menus, show one narrow high-confidence format and optionally Mixed menu only when no direction reaches threshold. Prefer specific recurring signals over daily_plates.
homepage_policy.display_fallback: If only one signal passes threshold, show one label. If no label passes or evidence is thin, show none / omit chip; never force a category.

observed_examples.note: Falafel is explicit evidence; other menu items suggest a mixed offer, so cuisine signal should require repetition across dates.

assignment_rules.evidence: Classify only from menu dish titles and explicit accompanying description. Do not use restaurant name, official Boni service tags, city, price or logo as classification evidence. Treat menu items as multiple dishes and allow multiple labels when each independently meets threshold.
assignment_rules.confidence: high: >=5 distinct supporting items across >=2 offered menu dates; medium: >=3 items in one date or >=3 items across menu periods; low: weaker, conflicting or title-only ambiguous. Homepage labels require medium or high; low evidence yields no label.
assignment_rules.mixed_menus: Score menu section share by distinct main dish titles. Mixed cuisine permits several directions if each meets its own evidence threshold; otherwise retain a format tag only or abstain. Avoid generalizing a single dish to the entire restaurant.
assignment_rules.dietary: No gluten-free, allergen-safe, vegan, healthy or halal guarantee from names. Dietary tags require an explicit menu assertion and remain dish-scoped; never infer allergen safety.
assignment_rules.missing_menu: Return status missing_menu/insufficient_evidence and empty labels; do not substitute restaurant name/category guesses. Retry only on a later scheduled refresh, not every app start.

classification_prompt: Classify a restaurant from the supplied Slovenian menu titles and their menu dates only. Ignore restaurant name, official service categories, branding, location and price. Use taxonomy version 1.0 IDs only. Count distinct main dishes by the taxonomy rules; assign at most two meal_format labels and one cuisine_direction label, only when each reaches its evidence threshold. Mixed menus may receive multiple independent labels; do not force one cuisine. If evidence is thin, inconsistent, or unavailable, return thin/missing_menu and no labels. Dietary/allergen claims are out of scope unless explicitly stated for a particular dish; never claim gluten-free or allergen safety. Return only JSON matching the schema, with up to three short dish-title evidence strings per label.

caching.key: Hash of normalized menu titles + relevant accompaniment text, restaurant ID, menu date window, taxonomy version and model identifier.
caching.normalization: Unicode normalize; lowercase; normalize whitespace/punctuation and collapse menu numbering; keep meaningful Slovenian tokens/diacritics. Sort normalized distinct items for stable hash while retaining raw text separately for evidence.
caching.refresh: Fetch on a bounded background refresh cadence or when menu data changes. Reuse the cached classification on app launch; call the model only on cache miss or material content/taxonomy/model version change. Cache empty/insufficient outcomes too with a shorter expiry.
